login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your organisations.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This page does not exist, or your roles do not give access to it.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.subtitle: One organisation per customer, each with its owner, members and products.
organisations.empty: No organisation yet. Create the first one with the "New organisation" button.

create.title: New organisation
create.name: Name
create.nameDescription: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Cannot be changed later: it is the identifier.
create.nameInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens only
create.emailDomainsDescription: Users with these domains are sent to this organisation when they log in. Press Enter or a comma after each domain.
create.ownerDescription: An existing user is reused, unless they already belong to another organisation.

delete.title: Delete the organisation {{org}}?
delete.message: Its client, its groups and the products assigned to it are deleted. The users are kept, but lose their access to the organisation. This cannot be undone.

products.subtitle: What the organisation negotiated for each product: its quota, the roles it bought, its parameters. The API of the product counts the usage.
products.removeMessage: The members of the organisation lose this product.

assign.title: Assign a product to {{org}}
assign.noProductLeft: Every product of the catalogs is already assigned
assign.boughtRolesDescription: The roles of the product the organisation bought: its teams can give these, never more.
assign.tokenHint: In the tokens, once a team of the organisation gives the product:
